verdict.rationale: Browserbase's docs describe programmatic control of hosted browser sessions through an official SDK and Stagehand, including full browser control with auto-waits, network interception, multi-tab support and self-healing actions. Its materials also mention form filling and agents that click through sites, which covers scripting interactions before extracting content. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of scrolling and of specific click/fill APIs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the interaction scripting.
